title: World Peace Through Meditation —
intro1: At Golden Age, we believe that every person carries energy, and meditation has the power to transform that energy into peace, positivity, and harmony. We believe that even one person meditating can become a source of positive energy, radiating peace and harmony into their surroundings. This energy can amplify positive vibrations throughout the area, creating a ripple effect that extends beyond the individual.
intro2: Imagine hundreds or thousands of people meditating in a city. We envision their collective meditative energy creating a powerful field of positive vibrations, contributing to a peaceful atmosphere, reducing aggression, violence, and crime, and encouraging harmony among people, plants, animals, and nature.
intro3: Our mission is to bring meditation into every home, every community, and every city. By encouraging more people to meditate, we aim to amplify this collective positive energy, support the well-being of all living beings, and contribute to a more peaceful and harmonious Earth.
closing: One person. One positive vibration. One ripple of change. Together, a peaceful world.
dotsCaption: Every lit dot is a meditator · be the next one
